english: Jami, a GNU package, is software for universal and distributed peer-to-peer communication that respects the freedom and privacy of its users. Visit <jamiLink>jami.net</jamiLink> to learn more.
translation: GNU paketi boʻlgan Jami — qurilmalar oʻrtasida bevosita ishlaydigan universal va taqsimlangan aloqa dasturi boʻlib, foydalanuvchilarning erkinligi va maxfiyligini hurmat qiladi. Batafsil maʼlumot uchun <jamiLink>jami.net</jamiLink> saytiga kiring.

english: This is a list of people who have made a significant investment of time, with useful results, into Jami. Any such contributors who want to be added to the list should contact us.
translation: Bu roʻyxatda Jami rivojiga koʻp vaqt sarflagan va foydali natijalarga erishgan insonlar keltirilgan. Roʻyxatga qoʻshilishni istagan hissa qoʻshuvchilar biz bilan bogʻlanishlari mumkin.

english: This program comes with absolutely no warranty. See the <gplLink>GNU General Public License</gplLink>, version 3 or later for details.
translation: Ushbu dastur hech qanday kafolatsiz taqdim etiladi. Batafsil maʼlumot uchun <gplLink>GNU Umumiy ommaviy litsenziyasi</gplLink> (3-versiya yoki undan keyingi) matniga qarang.

english: Guest authentication enables users to access an ephemeral account. Guest login allows users to chat without requiring any information or credentials to be provided.

english: Local authentication allows users to register an account by providing a username. The account is created and managed directly by the server. If the server's data is deleted, the account and its access will be permanently lost.

english: JAMS is the authentication service provided by Savoir-faire Linux Inc., enabling companies to manage secure access and user authentication efficiently.
translation: JAMS — Savoir-faire Linux Inc. tomonidan taqdim etiladigan autentifikatsiya xizmati boʻlib, kompaniyalarga xavfsiz kirish va foydalanuvchilar autentifikatsiyasini samarali boshqarish imkonini beradi.

translation: Ushbu hisobni guruh qoʻngʻiroqlarini oʻtkazadigan uchrashuv nuqtasiga aylantirish.

english: The choice of the name Jami was inspired by the Swahili word “jamii”, which means “community” as a noun and “together” as an adverb.
translation: Jami nomi suaxili tilidagi “jamii” soʻzidan ilhomlanib tanlangan; u ot sifatida “jamiyat”, ravish sifatida esa “birgalikda” degan maʼnoni bildiradi.

english: What is the green dot next to my account?
A red dot means that your account is disconnected from the network; it turns green when it's connected.
translation: Qizil nuqta hisobingiz tarmoqdan uzilganini bildiradi; ulanganda u yashil rangga oʻzgaradi.

english: Why should I back up my account?
translation: Nega hisobimning zaxira nusxasini yaratishim kerak?

english: Jami is distributed and your account is only stored locally on your device. If you lose your password or your local account data, you WILL NOT be able to recover your account if you did not back it up earlier.
translation: Jami taqsimlangan tizim boʻlib, hisobingiz faqat qurilmangizda mahalliy saqlanadi. Agar parolingizni yoki mahalliy hisob maʼlumotlaringizni yoʻqotsangiz va avval zaxira nusxa yaratmagan boʻlsangiz, hisobingizni TIKLAY OLMAYSIZ.

english: Can I make a conference call?
In a call, you can click on “Invite members” to add a contact to a call.
translation: Qoʻngʻiroq paytida kontaktni qoʻngʻiroqqa qoʻshish uchun “Aʼzolarni taklif qilish” tugmasini bosishingiz mumkin.

english: A Jami account is an asymmetric encryption key. Your account is identified by a Jami ID, which is a fingerprint of your public key.
translation: Jami hisobi — bu asimmetrik shifrlash kaliti. Hisobingiz Jami ID orqali aniqlanadi; Jami ID ochiq kalitingizning barmoq izidir.

english: What information do I need to provide to create a Jami account?
translation: Jami hisobini yaratish uchun qanday maʼlumotlarni taqdim etishim kerak?

english: When you create a new Jami account, you do not have to provide any private information like an email, address, or phone number.
translation: Yangi Jami hisobini yaratishda elektron pochta, manzil yoki telefon raqami kabi hech qanday shaxsiy maʼlumotni taqdim etishingiz shart emas.

english: Why don’t I have to use a password?
With Jami, your account is stored in a directory on your device. The password is only used to encrypt your account in order to protect you from someone who has physical access to your device.
translation: Jami ishlatganingizda hisobingiz qurilmangizdagi jildda saqlanadi. Parol faqat hisobingizni shifrlash uchun ishlatiladi — bu sizni qurilmangizga jismoniy kirish imkoniga ega boʻlgan shaxslardan himoya qiladi.

english: Why don’t I have to register a username?
translation: Nega foydalanuvchi nomini roʻyxatdan oʻtkazishim shart emas?

english: The most permanent, secure identifier is your Jami ID, but since these are difficult to use for some people, you also have the option of registering a username.
translation: Eng doimiy va xavfsiz identifikator — bu sizning Jami ID; ammo baʼzi odamlar uchun undan foydalanish qiyin boʻlgani sababli, foydalanuvchi nomini roʻyxatdan oʻtkazish imkoniyati ham mavjud.

english: How can I back up my account?
In Account Settings, a button is available to create a backup of your account.
translation: Hisob sozlamalarida hisobingizning zaxira nusxasini yaratish tugmasi mavjud.

english: What happens when I delete my account?
Your account is only stored on your own devices. If you delete your account from all of your devices, the account is gone forever and you CANNOT recover it.
translation: Hisobingiz faqat oʻz qurilmalaringizda saqlanadi. Agar hisobingizni barcha qurilmalaringizdan oʻchirsangiz, u butunlay yoʻqoladi va uni TIKLAY OLMAYSIZ.

english: Can I use my account on multiple devices?
translation: Hisobimdan bir nechta qurilmada foydalana olamanmi?

english: Yes, you can link your account from the settings, or you can import your backup on another device.
translation: Ha, hisobingizni sozlamalar orqali bogʻlashingiz yoki zaxira nusxangizni boshqa qurilmaga import qilishingiz mumkin.

translation: Foydalanuvchi nomi notoʻgʻri. Toʻgʻri foydalanuvchi nomini kiriting.

translation: Foydalanuvchi nomi notoʻgʻri. Toʻgʻri foydalanuvchi nomini kiriting.

translation: Foydalanuvchi nomi 3 tadan 32 tagacha belgidan iborat boʻlishi kerak.

Kirish kaliti orqali autentifikatsiya amalga oshmadi
